EXPRESS COLLECTIBLES — BUSINESS CARD (Neon Arcade / Miami Sunset)
Styled from www.expresscollectibles.com: exact site tokens — bg #150f2e, deep #0b071a, neon pink #ff3ea5, cyan #29e6ff, gold #ffc857, chrome-gradient italic wordmark, ticker bar, synthwave grid.
Artboards are full-bleed 3.625×2.125 in at 96 px/in (348×204 px); trim = 3.5×2 in (6 px off each edge).
The QR is a vCard: scanning saves Neal's full contact card — name, shop, (618) 882-1041, 906 Broadway, neal@expresscollectibles.com, the site and every handle (Whatnot/FB @expresscollectibles, eBay neal_knebel, IG/TikTok @nealknebelofficial). The eBay store 'Highland Express Collectibles' lives at ebay.com/str/expressplug with seller username neal_knebel — the card shows the username.
BEFORE PRINT: the bare domain expresscollectibles.com still shows the Squarespace 'coming soon' page — the card prints the working WWW form; point the apex at the live site when you can. Also make sure neal@expresscollectibles.com exists (forwarding to Neal's Gmail).
300-dpi print files: express-collectibles/business-card/print/ in the Fenix5ive repo.
